name: OPC UA Source
shortDescription: Connect to your OPC UA server to ingest data into Quix.

Variables.Name: output
Variables.Description: This is the Quix Topic that will receive the stream

Variables.Name: OPCUA_CONNECTION
Variables.Description: OPC UA server URL and namespace from a shared Variable Group.
Variables.VariableGroupDescription: Shared OPC UA server URL and namespace.

Variables.Description: URL of your OPC UA server. Defaults to the bundled OPC UA Server sample on the internal Quix network
Namespace of the data coming from your OPC UA server

Variables.Name: PARAMETER_NAMES_TO_PROCESS
Variables.Description: List of parameters from your OPC UA server that you want to process. e.g. ['a', 'b', 'c']. NB:Use single quotes.

Variables.Name: LOGLEVEL
Variables.Description: Desired loglevel; Use 'DEBUG' to see change events, else INFO for max performance.
